title: Canadian Financial Work Execution Feature Procurement
claim_boundary: Tasks prepare evidence and review workflows. They do not authorize accounting postings, tax assertions, government actions, payments, filings, or representative actions.
data_boundary: Real financial evidence and real monetary records remain outside Git. Repository fixtures are synthetic.

tasks.title: Authenticated tenant-scoped Financial Evidence tab
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-001 and authorize one bounded implementation slice.
acceptance_tests: Feature is disabled by default.
Authenticated principal and tenant scope are required before data access.
Cross-tenant read, export, cache, trace, and artifact access are denied.
Only allowlisted projection fields render; raw source evidence and opaque references do not render.
No external action occurs.
tasks.rollback: Disable the feature flag and revoke projection-reader authorization.

tasks.title: Secure external financial evidence store
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-002 after accepting the storage, residency, retention, and cost design.
acceptance_tests: Real evidence is stored outside Git using tenant-scoped encryption and authorization.
Immutable generations, checksums, retention, legal hold, deletion, export, backup, and restore are tested.
File type, size, archive, malware, parser, and content limits fail closed.
Object access and audit receipts bind principal, tenant, purpose, revision, and expiry.
tasks.rollback: Revoke access, stop ingestion, quarantine objects, preserve audit history, and restore only through an approved recovery plan.

tasks.title: Receipt ingestion and reconciliation core
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-003 after the external evidence store passes isolation and recovery gates.
acceptance_tests: Imports are idempotent and order independent.
Itemized receipts and payment-processor settlements reconcile without double counting.
Refunds, reversals, failed payments, obligations, and indeterminate outcomes retain distinct states.
Duplicate relationships preserve all source evidence and reviewer rationale.
All totals use integer minor units and explicit currency.
tasks.rollback: Disable the importer and rebuild projections from immutable evidence without deleting source records.

tasks.title: GitHub billing read-only import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-004 and identify the exact personal or organization billing scope.
acceptance_tests: Connector uses the least-privilege read-only billing scope.
Usage, included allowance, invoice, credit, and settled payment remain distinct.
Pagination, period boundaries, currency, duplicate retry, revocation, and provider errors are tested.
A provider receipt proves the exact read; no GitHub settings are changed.
tasks.rollback: Revoke connector access and rebuild the projection without GitHub records.

tasks.title: AI subscription receipt import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select exact providers and exact evidence sources; broad mailbox access is not implicit.
acceptance_tests: Each provider parser is separately allowlisted and versioned.
Renewal, expiration, failed-payment, invoice, and settlement evidence remain separate.
Currency, tax, period, refund, and processor overlap are preserved.
Connector access is read-only, revocable, and bounded to approved evidence.
tasks.rollback: Revoke source access, stop parsing, and supersede derived records without deleting evidence.

tasks.title: Apple and App Store receipt import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-006 and approve only a receipt source; Apple credentials are prohibited.
acceptance_tests: Itemized receipts and payment-processor evidence reconcile without double counting.
Personal, family, business-candidate, and mixed use remain review states.
Refunds and subscription changes preserve source lineage.
No Apple login, password, MFA, card, or account mutation is performed.
tasks.rollback: Revoke source access and exclude Apple-derived projections while retaining audit lineage.

tasks.title: Google Play receipt import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-007 and approve only a receipt source; Google account mutation is prohibited.
acceptance_tests: Itemized receipts, renewals, refunds, taxes, and processor evidence retain distinct provenance.
Subscription cycles reconcile deterministically.
Personal and business allocation remains human reviewed.
No subscription, payment-method, or account setting is changed.
tasks.rollback: Revoke source access and exclude Google Play-derived projections while retaining audit lineage.

tasks.title: Mobile carrier bill import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select the exact carrier and approved document source; carrier login automation is prohibited.
acceptance_tests: Billing periods, taxes, devices, service, financing, credits, and one-time charges remain distinct.
Phone and account identifiers are redacted before projection.
Mixed personal/business use enters a human allocation queue.
Missing periods are reported and never imputed as settled cash.
tasks.rollback: Revoke source access and quarantine carrier-derived records.

tasks.title: Human business-use allocation review
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-009 and designate an accountable reviewer.
acceptance_tests: Allocation records the reviewer, evidence references, percentage or classification, timestamp, and supersession.
Personal, mixed, candidate, and unallocated states are not tax conclusions.
Allocation cannot change settlement evidence or create a tax deduction.
Material changes require a new review event.
tasks.rollback: Supersede the allocation decision and return the item to unallocated without rewriting source evidence.

tasks.title: Project-scoped time evidence import
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select exact projects and time sources; scenario hours are not evidence.
acceptance_tests: Time evidence binds project, activity, period, source, and correction history.
Overlapping time across projects is rejected or explicitly resolved.
A selected rate requires documented time and a named comparator basis.
Founder-effort values have zero effect on cash, tax, payroll, expense, liability, and revenue totals.
tasks.rollback: Remove the selected management scenario and retain the source/correction trail.

tasks.title: Accountant export preview
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P0-011 for a local preview only; external delivery is a separate action.
acceptance_tests: Preview is redacted, tenant scoped, schema versioned, and content digested.
Settlement, obligation, economic-event candidate, founder estimate, and unresolved items remain separate.
No accounting posting or tax assertion is emitted.
No email, upload, share, or external delivery occurs.
tasks.rollback: Delete the local preview and preserve its generation receipt.

tasks.title: Entity and reporting-period registry
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-001 and supply authoritative, redacted entity evidence.
acceptance_tests: Entity type, jurisdiction, effective dates, fiscal periods, and registration states are owner reviewed.
Missing facts fail closed and are not inferred from purchases or repository history.
Sensitive identifiers remain in the approved external evidence store.
tasks.rollback: Supersede incorrect entity facts and invalidate dependent preparation packets.

tasks.title: CRA and Alberta obligation preparation
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-002 for internal preparation only.
acceptance_tests: T2125, T2, AT1, GST/HST, payroll, records, representative, registry, WCB, and PIPA questions are source bound.
Unknown entity, period, supply, employee, worker, and authority facts block conclusions.
No government login, registration, filing, payment, communication, or representative action occurs.
tasks.rollback: Invalidate the preparation packet and preserve the superseding source/version reason.

tasks.title: Record-specific retention and legal hold
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-003 after privacy and records review.
acceptance_tests: Retention is record and jurisdiction specific rather than one global duration.
Legal hold blocks deletion.
Export, deletion, restoration, and supersession produce immutable receipts.
A tested restore demonstrates recoverability.
tasks.rollback: Freeze deletion, restore the last verified generation, and require records review.

tasks.title: Accountant review workspace
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-004 and approve the exact professional identity and tenant scope.
acceptance_tests: Professional reviewer identity, scope, decisions, comments, and expiry are attributable.
Reviewer access is least privilege and revocable.
Review does not itself post, file, pay, or communicate with government.
Corrections append and supersede.
tasks.rollback: Revoke reviewer access and quarantine shared projections without erasing review history.

tasks.title: GST/HST threshold monitor
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-005 as a review signal, not a registration decision.
acceptance_tests: Single-quarter and prior-four-quarter inputs are explicit and effective dated.
Supply classification, associated-person rules, charities, exceptions, and voluntary registration remain unresolved unless reviewed.
Threshold evidence emits an alert for professional review and never registers an account.
tasks.rollback: Disable alerts and invalidate conclusions tied to superseded inputs or rules.

tasks.title: WCB-Alberta and Alberta PIPA preparation
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P1-006 for questions and evidence preparation only.
acceptance_tests: Industry, worker, contractor, coverage, and account facts remain explicit unknowns until reviewed.
Personal-information purposes, consent, safeguards, access, retention, correction, and breach handling are inventoried.
No WCB registration, report, premium, clearance, or government communication occurs.
tasks.rollback: Invalidate the preparation packet and preserve the superseding review.

tasks.title: Project and engagement cost allocation
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P2-001 after human allocation review is operational.
acceptance_tests: Allocated amounts reconcile to source evidence.
Shared and mixed costs remain explicit.
Client, project, and engagement data cannot cross tenant boundaries.
Allocation does not create a tax assertion.
tasks.rollback: Supersede allocations and rebuild projections from source evidence.

tasks.title: Budget, runway, and variance projection
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P2-002 and approve assumptions and planning horizons.
acceptance_tests: Forecasts and scenarios are visually and structurally separate from settled cash.
Assumptions, versions, confidence, and sensitivity ranges are recorded.
No forecast is presented as revenue, cash, entitlement, or financing.
tasks.rollback: Retire the forecast version without changing historical evidence.

tasks.title: Revenue and invoice evidence register
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P2-003 and define the approved client/engagement scope.
acceptance_tests: Proposal, contract, invoice, receivable, settlement, refund, and revenue-recognition states remain separate.
No synthetic fixture is counted as a client, invoice, revenue, or payment.
Client evidence is tenant isolated and consent/contract scoped.
tasks.rollback: Disable revenue projections and invalidate derived records without deleting source evidence.

tasks.title: Subscription renewal and anomaly queue
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P2-004 and define notification recipients; cancellation and payment stay prohibited.
acceptance_tests: Alerts cite evidence and distinguish obligations from settlements.
False positives and dismissals are measured.
No subscription is cancelled, renewed, upgraded, downgraded, or paid.
tasks.rollback: Disable notifications and preserve alert history.

tasks.title: Professional export package
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select export format and reviewer; sending remains a separate exact action.
acceptance_tests: Export schema/profile is approved by the recipient professional.
Manifest, source lineage, digest, limitations, and unresolved items are included.
Destination and content preview are exact.
Generation does not send, upload, post, file, or pay.
tasks.rollback: Delete the generated export and preserve its receipt.

tasks.title: Financial-control observability
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P2-006 and approve a redacted telemetry contract.
acceptance_tests: Metrics and traces exclude raw evidence, financial free text, personal data, and opaque source references.
Tenant labels cannot expose client identity.
Import, reconciliation, authorization, cost, error, and SLO signals are measurable.
tasks.rollback: Disable telemetry export and revoke collector access.

tasks.title: Accounting-system read adapter
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select an exact provider for read-only sandbox research.
acceptance_tests: Read-only sandbox access is least privilege and revocable.
Account maps and imported records are previews.
Provider reads reconcile and emit receipts.
No accounting mutation occurs.
tasks.rollback: Revoke the adapter and delete derived previews.

tasks.title: Accounting posting proposal
tasks.user_choice_gate: Select CAFIN-P3-002 for internal proposal research only.
acceptance_tests: Proposal is balanced, source linked, reversible in preview, and independently reviewed.
Posting, tax, and payroll conclusions remain marked as unexecuted.
No provider write occurs.
tasks.rollback: Invalidate the proposal without modifying an accounting system.

tasks.title: Human-controlled accounting post
tasks.user_choice_gate: Requires a new external-action authorization after P3-002 acceptance.
acceptance_tests: Exact immutable payload, destination, tenant, period, actor, approval, nonce, expiry, and revision are bound.
Single-use permit consumption is atomic.
Provider state is reconciled and a compensating path is tested.
An authorized accounting professional remains accountable.
tasks.rollback: Use an approved compensating entry; never erase the original posting or receipt.

tasks.title: Certified tax-software handoff research
tasks.user_choice_gate: Requires separate legal, terms, security, and professional research authorization.
acceptance_tests: Certified-software and API requirements are independently verified.
Sandbox uses synthetic data and no CRA credentials.
No return is filed, amended, transmitted, signed, or paid.
tasks.rollback: Remove the research adapter and revoke sandbox access.

tasks.title: Government-submission architecture research
tasks.user_choice_gate: Requires a new explicit research authorization and written qualified review.
acceptance_tests: Legal, security, privacy, identity, professional-responsibility, and provider requirements are documented.
An authorized human controls identity-bound attestations and submission.
AIGC never handles CRA credentials, MFA, recovery material, or representative authority.
No live government submission occurs.
tasks.rollback: Terminate research and revoke all sandbox or partner access.

tasks.title: Payment and remittance architecture research
tasks.user_choice_gate: Requires a new explicit research authorization; no payment authority is granted.
acceptance_tests: Threat model covers fraud, destination substitution, amount mutation, duplicate payment, uncertain outcome, coercion, and account takeover.
Dual control, exact payload binding, reconciliation, limits, emergency stop, and incident response are designed and exercised with synthetic data.
No live payment, remittance, transfer, card charge, or refund occurs.
tasks.rollback: Stop research, destroy synthetic credentials, and preserve the research decision record.
